title: La vie est bonne
text: people who are awake to what i call the evolutionary impulse are alive with the thrill of existence they know that life is good they know that the aspiration to exist is good they know it they they have absolute conviction that life is good and the desire to exist is good and they also know as because of that and only because of that their existence here at this time is meaningful because they know that existence is good because they know that because they don't have any doubt about it it's because of that that they know that their presence here is potentially very very meaningful because if you know and you have no existential doubt whatsoever no doubt whatsoever that life is good then your existence has meaning because you feel compelled from a spiritual source by from a deeper source that comes from deeper sources from the personal ego or the or the cultural self you feel compelled then to manifest that drive which is goodness itself you feel compelled to do it from a deeper source and without without this vehicle without your body your mind your personality without all of your without all of yourself without all of your without your body without your personal life experience psychological experience emotional experience with all of your cultural experience you wouldn't be able to do it all of your historical cultural conditioning and training in your education and your highly developed cognition and your highly developed individuation all these then become the vehicle for the evolution of the process so your own highly evolved self culturally evolved self cognitively evolved self that is a vehicle for the evolution of the interior of the cosmos so then you become a vehicle for for taking the whole process forward and instead of your body being a problem in your mind being a problem and culture being a problem and all these they actually become vehicles for the highest end and then you and you see how lucky you are then your your body your mind all of your life experience all of your cultural heritage and all of your capacity to develop you see you want to make good on all of it because that's everything you have to work with all of everything that we all are is everything that we have to work with to make a difference so then being you suddenly becomes a wonderful thing not a problem that you need to overcome you
